description.value:
Whether you know it or not, you are a child of Asmodeus. Your nature might be hinted at by strange and disturbing dreams, devilish features, or talents that some would say are unnatural. But like every child, there comes a time in your life when you must decide if you will follow in your father's footsteps or walk the other way—to embrace oppression and tyranny, or join the fight against them. It would be perfectly natural for you to embrace your nature and glorify the edicts of the Church of Asmodeus, but will your heritage define you, or will you define yourself?

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Devil Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Hellish Impression] reaction.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
